products.name: Mariyam Maquillage Hydra-Velvet Transfer-Proof Liquid Lipstick

shades.name: Bombay Nude
shades.description: Warm peachy nude that flatters all Indian undertones without washing out

shades.name: Gulab Crimson
shades.description: Velvety rose-wine with regal ruby undertones for festive celebrations

shades.name: Chai Spice
shades.description: Toasted cinnamon brown enriched with warm terracotta notes

shades.name: Kolhapur Berry
shades.description: Deep seductive plum berry with modern editorial intensity

shades.name: Sindoor Scarlet
shades.description: Classic royal bride scarlet with balanced undertones that make teeth look brighter

benefits: 12-hour transfer-proof wear without lip crackling or drying
Richly pigmented one-swipe full color payoff
Infused with hyaluronic filling spheres for plush, plump comfort
Precise diamond applicator for clean lip contours
products.howToUse: Outline lips starting at cupid's bow using the pointed tip. Fill in with smooth strokes. Allow 90 seconds to dry into a transfer-resistant velvet veil.
products.ingredientsList: Isododecane, Dimethicone, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Tocopheryl Acetate, CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 15850.
products.shortDescription: Velvety transfer-resistant lip color enriched with nourishing almond oil and lip-smoothing hyaluronic spheres.
products.fullDescription: A groundbreaking comfortable matte liquid lipstick crafted to stay put through festive feasts and long wedding nights without drying your lips.

products.name: Mariyam Maquillage 24K Micro-Mist Lock & Fixer Spray (100ml)
benefits: Locks makeup for 24 hours against tropical heat & monsoons
Ultra-fine micro-aerosol delivers cloud-like mist without droplets
Provides subtle golden glow without chunky glitter
Calms redness with distilled Kannauj rosewater
products.howToUse: Shake vigorously to suspend gold particulates. Hold bottle 8-10 inches from face and mist evenly in an 'X' and 'T' pattern across set makeup.
products.ingredientsList: Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Aqua, PVP, Glycerin, 24K Gold, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Disodium EDTA.
products.shortDescription: All-day humidity-proof setting spray with suspended 24K gold flakes and distilled Kannauj rosewater.
products.fullDescription: Engineered specifically for Indian climates, this weightless mist creates an invisible water-resistant shield while imparting a celestial golden hour radiance.

products.name: Mariyam Maquillage Midnight Renewal Multi-Ceramide Barrier Cream
keyIngredients: 5 Essential Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP, NS, AS)
benefits: Restores compromised skin barrier within 3 nights
Calms irritation triggered by extreme urban pollution & heat
Bakuchiol encourages gentle cellular renewal without retinol sensitivity
Plumping peptide hydration without greasy residue
products.howToUse: Warm a pea-sized portion between fingertips. Gently press into face, neck and décolletage as the final step of your PM beauty ritual.
products.ingredientsList: Aqua, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Bakuchiol, Centella Asiatica Extract, Avena Sativa Kernel Flour, Squalane.
products.shortDescription: Ultra-restorative evening cream packed with 5 bio-identical ceramides and gentle bakuchiol.
products.fullDescription: An intensive night balm formulated to heal stressed skin barriers damaged by pollution, heavy makeup, and changing Indian weather.

products.name: Mariyam Maquillage Luminous Peptide Glaze Dew Drops
benefits: Instantly confers glass-skin reflective finish with zero stickiness
Functions as a primer serum under foundation or natural highlighter
Boosts skin elasticity with bioactive copper peptides
Non-comedogenic and light on pores
products.howToUse: Apply 2-3 drops directly onto bare skin before moisturizer, mix 1 drop with foundation for enhanced luminosity, or pat over cheekbones as a high-shine glaze.
products.ingredientsList: Aqua, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Copper Tripeptide-1, Sodium Hyaluronate, Citrullus Lanatus Fruit Extract, Panthenol, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol.
products.shortDescription: Multitasking peptide serum and liquid glaze primer that delivers glass skin radiance.
products.fullDescription: Formulated for instant glass-skin dewy radiance that also works as an ultra-hydrating makeup base.

products.name: Kay Beauty Matteinee Matte Lip Crayon by Katrina Kaif
benefits: Enriched with nourishing African Marula oil for velvety glide
High-impact matte color with weightless feel
Easy sharpenable crayon format with precision tip
products.howToUse: Glide effortlessly across lips. Layer for richer intensity.

products.name: Minimalist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ with Niacinamide & Vitamin B5
benefits: Zero white cast guaranteed on deep Indian skin tones
Tested PA++++ broad spectrum protection against UVA & UVB rays
Lightweight lotion texture that does not clog pores or pill under makeup
products.howToUse: Apply two finger lengths generously to face and neck 15 minutes before stepping into the sun. Reapply every 2-3 hours.

products.name: Dot & Key Ceramides & Hyaluronic Skin Barrier Repair Cream
benefits: Deep moisture infusion for 72 hours
Soothes itchy, irritated or peeling skin barrier
Smooth whipped texture that absorbs cleanly
products.howToUse: Massage into cleansed face and neck morning and evening.

products.name: SUGAR Cosmetics Stroke of Genius Heavy-Duty Kohl Kajal - 01 Back to Black
benefits: Ultra-creamy waterproof glide for waterline and tightline
Jet black matte finish that stays 12 hours without raccoon eyes
Free of parabens and ophthalmologist certified
products.howToUse: Swipe across waterline. Smudge along lash line with a brush for a dramatic smoky Indian eye.

products.name: M.A.C Studio Fix Fluid SPF 15 24HR Matte Foundation
benefits: 24-hour oil-control matte finish
Iconic NC (Neutral Cool/Golden) & NW shades
Full camera-ready coverage without cakey texture
products.howToUse: Buff into skin using a dense foundation brush starting from the center of the face.

products.name: Huda Beauty Empowered Luxury Eyeshadow Palette
benefits: 18 opulent buttery shades in coppers, golds, and buttery mattes
High pigment payoff tailored for diverse skin tones
Long-wear gel liners and wet-look foil toppers included
products.howToUse: Build your base with neutral mattes, and press metallic foil toppers with fingertips for ultra-reflective dimension.

products.name: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Magic Cream Instant Glow Moisturiser
benefits: Legendary red carpet moisturizer for instant lit-from-within cushion
Reduces fine line appearance under foundation
Nourishing formula beloved by celebrity makeup artists worldwide
products.howToUse: Apply the 'Tilbury Tap' massage across temples, jawline, and cheeks before foundation.

products.name: Mariyam Maquillage Oud & Velvet Rose Royale Eau de Parfum (100ml)
benefits: Handcrafted extrait de parfum with 25% fragrance oil concentration
Lasts 18+ hours on fabric and skin through Indian festivities
Rich harmonious sillage blending smoked agarwood with velvety Damascus roses
Bottled in heavyweight fluted crystal with 24K gold-plated cap
products.howToUse: Spray on pulse points: wrists, hollow of throat, behind ears, and scarf edges for majestic projection.
products.shortDescription: Regal Indian artisanal perfume combining Assam agarwood with opulent Taif rose petals.

products.name: Pilgrim Spanish Rosemary & Biotin Hair Growth Oil with Redensyl
benefits: Clinically proven hair follicle reactivation
Reduces postpartum and seasonal hair shedding
Non-sticky lightweight oil that washes out effortlessly
products.howToUse: Section dry hair and apply 5-10 drops directly to scalp using dropper. Massage gently for 5 minutes and leave for at least 1 hour or overnight.

products.name: Plum BodyLovin' Vanilla Vibes Body Butter for Dry Skin
benefits: Warm gourmand vanilla bakery fragrance that lingers all day
Intense moisture nourishment for 48 hours without greasy feel
100% vegan formula packed with cold-pressed botanical butters
products.howToUse: Slather over freshly bathed, towel-dried skin.

products.name: Bombay Shaving Company Beard Growth Oil with Vetiver & Jojoba
benefits: Strengthens roots and softens coarse beard bristles
Calms itchy under-beard skin with cooling vetiver aroma
Lightweight fast absorption
products.howToUse: Rub 4-6 drops between palms and massage through beard from roots to tips.

products.name: PAC Professional Master 12-Piece Artisanal Makeup Brush Kit with Bag
benefits: 12 essential brushes for face, eyes, and contour blending
Ultra-soft vegan bristles that do not shed or soak excess liquid
Includes water-resistant zip travel pouch
products.howToUse: Use dense brushes for liquid and cream blending, and fluffy brushes for setting powder, blush, and eyeshadow transitions.

product.howToUse: Dispense 1-2 pumps onto the back of your hand. Dot onto forehead, cheeks, and chin. Blend outwards using the Mariyam Artisanal Foundation Brush or damp sponge for a seamless second-skin radiance.

product.shortDescription: Weightless serum foundation offering radiant, buildable coverage with true-to-tone Indian undertone calibration.
product.fullDescription: Formulated specifically for the diverse depths and golden, warm, and olive undertones of Indian complexions. Unlike traditional foundations that ash out under flash photography, Royal Silk merges saffron bio-actives with micro-milled pigments to impart a natural lit-from-within royal glow.
